about: The falsifier: an identity walked out of what the instrument runs. bound's digest took the sources of every region its dependency lines name, so it walked the sibling topos/src and obligations/src, and never looked at the releases its own lock names.

bound had long run obligations from the 0.2.0 release laid under it, not from the sibling, yet an edit to the sibling moved bound's identity. Re-pinning a release changed the code bound runs and left its identity where it was, so the extension over the fixture was never measured again for it.

cases.name: the sibling topos/src/wire/index.ts edited and put back, on a scratch copy
cases.identity: walking the siblings: d7922d379f65, then 68d56000b89d, then d7922d379f65

cases.name: dep/topos re-pinned from b79df96e to 192a5138
cases.identity: walking the siblings, the same digest under either pin: the lines naming a release were never read
cases.extension: not measured again, and folds kept by the code before were served for the code after
